question: RB-02 q8: What Blueprint graph/node tools does Epic already have, and how far do they get?
answer: Epic ships a single BlueprintTools class (no separate BlueprintNodeTools). Graph authoring is extensive: primitive node ops plus read/write_graph_dsl round-trip.

ceiling_assessment.reaches: Full EventGraph/function graph node authoring, pin wiring, variable/function scaffolding, compile, and S-expression DSL import/export with automatic compile after write_graph_dsl
ceiling_assessment.does_not_reach: Stable cross-session graph JSON with revision/hash (DSL is text, node refs are UObject handles); envelope-shaped batch submit; verified round-trip status reporting; idempotency keys — UEREMCP ADR-0003/0004/0006 scope remains
ceiling_assessment.ws06_implication: WS-06 should compose over BlueprintTools + execute_tool_script rather than rebuild primitive node tools; POC A becomes DSL/graph-schema bridge + validation, not pin-by-pin authoring from scratch

reagenttools_claim_correction: REAgentTools docs reference BlueprintTools AND BlueprintNodeTools — only BlueprintTools exists in UE 5.8 EditorToolset [VERIFIED: __init__.py Registration list has blueprint.BlueprintTools only]
